why: Flagged 2026-11-08: a reply with two review groups (A: three calls, B: three calls), each a table whose Answer cell holds its choices as backtick letters with their words (`a` ... / `b` ...) and whose Recommended cell names only the letter. The sheet showed bare letters with no words, and both groups as one list. The choices come with their words, the recommended one is marked and shown by its words, and each group keeps its own heading and lead-in above its cards (one answer line still covers all six keys).
title: Nathan, I added this to the list as top priority. Two groups of questions to start the design are below. The sketch comes after your answers.
intro_starts: Nathan, I added this to the list

groups.label: A
groups.title: what "quiet" means
groups.text_starts: Answer these in order. P1 deci

cards.question: What a quiet session mutes
options: the app and the digest only: items 1-2 above, calendar and chat untouched
the app, the digest and the system: also switches the system mode on and off through your shortcut
the app's own badge and count only
cards.recommended: the app, the digest and the system: also switches the system mode on and off through your shortcut

cards.question: What happens to reminders that arrive during a quiet session
options: held, then shown as one short list when the session ends
dropped (they stay visible in the item list)
cards.recommended: held, then shown as one short list when the session ends

cards.question: Can anything break through
options: an item waiting on you for more than N minutes

cards.question: Session shape
options: classic: 25 min focus, 5 min break, a 15 min break after every 4, all editable
one block of a length you choose, no breaks
cards.recommended: classic: 25 min focus, 5 min break, a 15 min break after every 4, all editable

cards.question: Where the countdown shows
options: a pill in the toolbar plus a countdown in the menu bar
cards.recommended: a pill in the toolbar plus a countdown in the menu bar

cards.question: When a session ends
options: soft chime, then a "Session done" screen with Restart and Start break buttons, nothing starts on its own
the break starts on its own, then the next session
cards.recommended: the break starts on its own, then the next session
